title: Aerated Saudi-Arabian Cashews
description: A kid-friendly dish featuring cashews with a buttery and aerated finish, made vegan-friendly.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, grind the cashews into a fine powder.
Add the dates, coconut milk, lemon juice, water, salt, yeast, and baking powder to the blender.
Blend the mixture on high speed for 2 minutes, until it becomes light and frothy.
Stop the blender and scrape down the sides with a spatula.
Return the blender to high speed and continue blending for another minute, until the mixture becomes aerated and doubled in volume.
Pour the mixture into a bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow it to set.
Once set, use a spatula to scoop the aerated cashew mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
Refrigerate for an additional 30 minutes to chill before serving.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional cashews if desired.
To make the aerated finish more visible, top each serving with a dollop of whipped coconut cream or a sprinkle of matcha powder.
